title: Merge sort correctness and resource bound
statement: Let a program contain the specified sort, halving, merge, and copy procedures. Suppose its word limit is at least both the address-space size and $1$. Let $L$ be a list of integers, and let $[?25h[?25l[?25l[?25l$ be a memory function whose values on the interval starting at $a$ agree with $L$; assume $a+|L|\le fr$ and $fr+|L|\le$ the address-space size. For every recursion depth $d$ with $d+\lceil\log_2 |L|\rceil+1$ at most the depth limit, the sort procedure, given $|L|$, $a$, and $fr$, runs within $61|L|\lceil\log_2 |L|\rceil+74\max(|L|-1,0)+4$ steps and returns a list that is a sorted permutation of $L$ in the interval starting at $a$, while preserving memory at every address below $fr$ outside that interval.
